title: Baseline chat: example

panels.title: Scrape success (1h)
panels.description: What fraction of recorded scrapes succeeded in the last hour? This checks the metrics endpoint only. Missing history while Prometheus is stopped is not counted as failure.

panels.title: TTFT p95 (5m)

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{job="serving"}[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{job="serving"}[5m])))

panels.description: How long did the baseline chat engine take to produce a first token for 95% of requests over five minutes? Histogram estimate in seconds; idle windows can be NaN.

panels.title: Completed requests / min (5m)
panels.description: How many requests per minute finished with stop or length in this five-minute window? Abort and error outcomes are excluded. Completion does not establish output quality.

panels.title: TTFT p95 over time

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{job="serving"}[5m]))) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(vllm_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{job="serving"}[5m])))

panels.description: How long did the baseline chat engine take to produce a first token for 95% of requests over five minutes? Histogram estimate in seconds; idle windows can be NaN.

panels.title: Completed requests over time
panels.description: How many requests per minute finished with stop or length in this five-minute window? Abort and error outcomes are excluded. Completion does not establish output quality.

description: Example for the baseline chat engine, with no declared targets. Choose and adapt two or three indicators for the service you measure, then save as Team service. Both vllm: and vllm_ spellings are included as fallbacks; verify the actual names and job label in your TSDB. Scrape success measures recorded scrapes, not request availability. HTTP request outcomes need the separate http_requests_total family, if your server exposes it. These queries combine models within job=serving; filter model_name when measuring one of several models.
